snippet.title: Piece by Piece is OUT NOW on Steam!
snippet.description:
Piece by Piece is OUT NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179050/Piece_by_Piece/

It's time to open shop! Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!
